title: Hearty Crispy British Serrano Ham Skewers
description: A peppery, crispy, and savory British dish featuring serrano ham, miso-marinate, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, grilled to perfection on a robata-grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together miso paste, honey, and olive oil to make the miso-marinate.
Add the minced garlic and black pepper to the miso-marinate and whisk until well combined.
Thread the serrano ham, pineapple chunks, and cherry tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the miso-marinate onto both sides of the serrano ham and vegetables on the skewers.
Grill the skewers on the robata-grill for 10-12 minutes, or until the serrano ham is crispy and the vegetables are tender.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with additional miso-marinate on the side for dipping, if desired.
